# AccuMeasure Instruments Co., Ltd.

> Official website: https://www.accumeasuretech.com
> Company: AccuMeasure Instruments Co., Ltd. (西安精准测量仪器有限公司)
> Location: High-Tech Zone, Xi'an, Shaanxi, China

## What AccuMeasure covers

- Industrial level-sensing, flow-measurement, and pressure-measurement product categories.
- OEM/ODM and custom-project discussions after configuration requirements are reviewed.
- Application review, model confirmation, controlled technical-document requests, and RFQ preparation.

## Product categories

- Level sensors: capacitive, radar, ultrasonic, and connected models.
- Flow meters: electromagnetic, clamp-on ultrasonic, and thermal mass models.
- Pressure instruments: pressure transmitters and digital pressure gauges.

## Buyer guidance

- Start with the measured medium, range, tank or pipe details, process conditions, installation, output, and destination market.
- Request the current model-specific datasheet, drawing, document revision, and applicable compliance scope before approval.
- Confirm the exact configuration, inspection or calibration requirements, pricing, quantity, packaging, delivery, warranty, payment, and acceptance criteria in writing.
- Do not infer certification, availability, performance, or customer results from an old document, a category label, or a search snippet.

## RFQ and technical support

Send the product model or measurement duty, medium, range, pipe or tank details, output, installation constraints, destination market, quantity, and required documents through https://www.accumeasuretech.com/contact. Contact: info@accumeasuretech.com; +86-183-0928-5711.

## Evidence policy

Certificate scans, controlled datasheets, customer records, order quantities, test records, and project results are not public downloads by default. Ask for the current controlled revision and exact scope before relying on them.

## Document requests

- Request current datasheets, manuals, 3D models, certificate scans, and project documentation through https://www.accumeasuretech.com/contact.
- Include the product model and project scope so engineering can identify the current controlled document revision.
